summary: Tested the new proposal-acceptance / both-parties-completion / reviews iteration end-to-end. Backend: new pytest suite (38 cases) at /app/backend/tests/test_proposal_flow.py covering listings returning full docs, accept flow, status transitions, dual completion, review validation (polite language, min length, rating range, duplicate 409, aggregation) and guardrails. 33/34 core cases pass. Frontend: full UI E2E on the public URL with freshly registered accounts (1 client + 2 providers) — request creation, 2 offers, accept, non-selected offer remains visible, client completion note, provider completion, request/offer 'Concluído', ReviewModal stars, rude-language error, polite submit toast, duplicate 409 error. All requested feature behaviours verified working. Remaining issues are pre-existing/edge-case: 500 on malformed ObjectId, no authz on GET /requests/{id}/offers, duplicate offers from same provider allowed, provider catalog/portfolio endpoints still project only _id (carry-over from iteration 2), toast never auto-dismisses, login link hidden on mobile.

critical.issue: Malformed ObjectId (e.g. /api/offers/bogusid/accept) raises bson.errors.InvalidId -> HTTP 500 instead of 400/404. Confirmed in backend.err.log.
No authorization check: any authenticated user (another client or unrelated provider) can read all offers, prices and provider names of another client's request. Returns 200.

Carry-over from iteration 2 - still use projection {"_id":1}, so responses contain only id. Provider catalog list and client photo-authorization cards therefore render empty (no name/category/price/image_data/caption). test_phase2_features.py fails with KeyError 'name'.

minor.issue: Same provider can submit unlimited offers on the same open request (200 each). Provider dashboard 'Pedidos abertos' also keeps showing requests already quoted, so duplicates are easy to create; client then sees several cards from the same provider.

App CORSMiddleware only allows localhost/FRONTEND_URL, so preflight is answered by ingress with Access-Control-Allow-Origin:* and no allow-credentials. Real requests work (custom middleware echoes origin), but the config is inconsistent - test_promao_api.py::test_cors_is_explicit_and_credentials_allowed fails.
/app/memory/test_credentials.md suggests @promao.local emails, which EmailStr rejects (422 'special-use or reserved name'). Credentials doc should use a valid domain.

ui_bugs.issue: Toast never auto-dismisses and is not cleared on view change or logout. Stale messages such as 'Serviço concluído!' remain visible after logging out and while a different user's screen/ReviewModal is open.
'Avaliar atendimento' button stays enabled after the review is published (no 'Avaliado' state); clicking again produces the 409 error inside the modal instead of preventing it.
CSS .login-link{display:none} under 600px hides the 'Entrar' entry point on mobile; returning users must open 'Criar conta' and use the switch link to log in.

issues: Non-selected offer card uses opacity .6 on already-muted #64748b text, lowering contrast below comfortable readability
Chip label for pending offers reads 'Aguardando cliente' on the client's own screen, which is confusing wording for the client viewing it

action_items: Wrap ObjectId(...) parsing in try/except (or a helper) in accept/complete/reviews and return 400/404 instead of 500
Add ownership/participation check to GET /api/requests/{request_id}/offers (client owner or offering provider only)
Remove the {"_id":1} projections in /provider/catalog, /portfolio and /portfolio/pending so full documents (name, price, image_data, caption) are returned
Block duplicate offers from the same provider on the same request (409) and/or hide already-quoted requests in the provider 'Pedidos abertos' list
Auto-dismiss the toast (timeout) and clear message on view change/logout
Hide/disable 'Avaliar atendimento' once a review exists (expose review state per offer)
Make the login entry point reachable on mobile (<=600px)
Align app CORS allow_origins with the preview origin or drop the duplicate custom middleware; update /app/memory/test_credentials.md to a valid email domain
critical_code_review_comments: ObjectId conversions are inlined with __import__('bson').ObjectId everywhere - extract one helper that validates the id and raises HTTPException(400) to remove the 500s and the repetition
list_offers is the only offer read path and has no authz; accept/complete correctly validate ownership, so the gap is inconsistent with the rest of the module
App.js is a single 100-line minified-style file where each component is one very long line; ClientWorkspace/ProviderWorkspace/ReviewModal should be split into modules for maintainability
ClientWorkspace.accept/complete use setOffersMap({...offersMap, ...}) from a stale closure - use the functional updater to avoid dropping other requests' offers after rapid actions
No loading/disabled state on Aceitar proposta / Marcar como concluído / Publicar depoimento buttons; double clicks fire duplicate POSTs

success_rate.backend: 84% (32/38 incl. intentional guard-gap probes; 33/34 of the feature suite)

seed_data_creation: UI accounts (password Promao123!): cliente_q703a@example.com (client, 1 completed request + review), prest1_q703a@example.com, prest2_q703a@example.com (providers). API tests create disposable test_*@example.com users.
test_credentials: cliente_q703a@example.com / prest1_q703a@example.com / prest2_q703a@example.com — password Promao123!. Note: /app/memory/test_credentials.md still lists @promao.local addresses which the backend rejects (422).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new-iteration features (accept, not_selected visibility, dual completion, review polite check, duplicate 409, aggregation endpoint) are verified working on the public URL. Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_proposal_flow.py (TestGuardGaps intentionally fails until the 4 gaps are fixed). Still open from iteration 2: catalog/portfolio projections and Google session cookie name. Retest after the ObjectId/authz/projection fixes.
rca_of_the_issue: 500s come from bson.ObjectId() being called on unvalidated path/body ids inside the try-less handlers (accept/complete) and reviews. The offers-read leak is because list_offers filters only by request_id without comparing the caller to req.client_id or offer.provider_id. The empty catalog/portfolio lists are caused by Mongo projections {'_id':1} that strip every business field.
